source_excerpt:
Eligible Valmiki sanitation workers can receive ₹3 lakh for house construction.
Applicants must be Himachal Pradesh residents with an annual income of up to ₹2.50 lakh.
The Maharishi Valmiki Kamgar Awas Yojana targets eligible families who do not own a house.

The Himachal Pradesh Maharishi Valmiki Kamgar Awas Yojana is a state government housing assistance scheme run by the Social Justice and Empowerment Department . Under this initiative, eligible sanitation workers belonging to the Valmiki community receive financial assistance of ₹3 lakh to construct their own houses. This financial support helps eligible workers secure permanent housing and improve their living conditions. Chief Minister Thakur Sukhvinder Singh Sukhu first announced the scheme in the Himachal Pradesh Budget Speech 2024-25, and the State Cabinet later approved its launch.
The state government launched this scheme because many sanitation workers from the Valmiki community still live without a home of their own despite serving towns and villages every day. The objective of the Maharishi Valmiki Kamgar Awas Yojana is to provide these families with a permanent roof, improve their living standards, and help them lead a dignified life. Through this initiative, the government also aims to uplift underprivileged sections of society and bring them into the mainstream of development.
Under the Valmiki Kamgar Awas Scheme, an eligible beneficiary receives financial assistance of ₹3 lakh for the construction of a house. The benefit covers sanitation workers of the Valmiki community whose annual income is less than ₹2.5 lakh and who do not own a house. District administrations have also stated that applicants must be permanent residents of Himachal Pradesh and must not have received benefits under any other government housing scheme. The Department of Social Justice implements the scheme at the ground level through Tehsil Welfare Officers.
The application process for the Maharishi Valmiki Kamgar Awas Yojana is offline. Interested applicants need to contact their Tehsil Welfare Officer, collect the application form, attach the required documents, and submit the form at the same office. The government has amended the scheme to make the process more transparent and time-bound, and officers now have to communicate eligibility decisions, including the reasons for rejection, within a fixed period. The state government has not released any online application portal for this scheme so far.
Besides the Maharishi Valmiki Kamgar Awas Yojana, the Himachal Pradesh government is also running two other significant housing schemes aimed at the welfare of its citizens- the Mukhyamantri Apna Parivar Sukhi Parivar Yojana , which aims to support families in securing better living conditions, and the Mukhyamantri Vidhwa Evam Ekal Nari Awas Yojana , which provides housing assistance specifically to widows and single women to help them build their own homes. Interested applicants can explore the complete details of both schemes here.
The Maharishi Valmiki Kamgar Awas Yojana provides direct financial assistance to eligible sanitation workers to help them construct a permanent pucca house. Under this scheme, the following benefits are provided to beneficiaries for house construction:
Assistance Amount: ₹3 lakh for the construction of a house.
Permanent Shelter: Homeless sanitation worker families get the means to build a pucca house.
Better Living Standards: The scheme helps families move towards safer, healthier, and more dignified living conditions.
Priority Support: As per district administration briefings, disaster-affected families and applicants with more than 40% disability receive priority.
Time-Bound Decisions: Applicants receive a decision on their eligibility, with reasons in case of rejection, within a fixed time.
To be eligible for financial assistance under the Maharishi Valmiki Kamgar Awas Scheme, applicants are required to fulfil the following conditions.
The applicant must be a permanent resident of Himachal Pradesh.
The applicant must belong to the Valmiki community.
The applicant must work as a sanitation worker.
The annual family income must be less than ₹2.5 lakh.
The applicant must not own a house (pucca house).
Only one family member can receive the benefit.
The following documents may be required when applying for the Maharishi Valmiki Kamgar Awas Yojana. Applicants should contact their Tehsil Welfare Officer to confirm the complete list of required documents.
Himachal Pradesh Bonafide (permanent resident) Certificate
Certificate or proof of working as a sanitation worker
Applicants can apply for the Maharishi Valmiki Kamgar Awas Yojana through offline mode, as the concerned authority has not yet released any information about an online application process or portal for this scheme. Therefore, applicants should visit their Tehsil Welfare Office and complete the application process by following the steps provided below.
Visit the office of the Tehsil Welfare Officer in your respective tehsil.
Ask for the application form of the Maharishi Valmiki Kamgar Awas Yojana and the latest list of required documents.
Fill in the form carefully with your personal details, family details, income details, occupation details, and bank account information.
Attach self-attested copies of all required documents, such as the bonafide certificate, caste certificate, sanitation worker certificate, income certificate, land documents, and Aadhaar card.
Submit the completed form at the same welfare office and collect the receipt or application number, if the office issues one.
The welfare office verifies your documents and eligibility.
The concerned officer informs you about your eligibility within the stipulated time. If the office rejects the application, it must also share the reason for ineligibility.
After approval, the department releases the financial assistance for house construction.

1. What is the Maharishi Valmiki Kamgar Awas Yojana?
It is a Himachal Pradesh government scheme that gives ₹3 lakh to sanitation workers of the Valmiki community for building their own house.
Sanitation workers of the Valmiki community who are permanent residents of Himachal Pradesh, have an annual income below ₹2.5 lakh, and do not own a house can apply.
Applicants who own a pucca house, earn ₹2.5 lakh or more annually, or have already taken benefit under another government housing scheme are not eligible.
4. Can more than one family member take the benefit?
No, as per the district administration, only one member per family can receive the benefit.
You can get the application form from the office of the Tehsil Welfare Officer in your tehsil
6. Is the assistance paid in instalments?
The concerned authority has not yet released official information on the payment mode or instalments.
Disaster-affected families and applicants with more than 40% disability get priority, as per district administration briefings.
8. Which department implements the scheme?
The Department of Social Justice and Empowerment, Government of Himachal Pradesh, implements the scheme.
9. How will I know whether my application is approved?
The concerned officer informs applicants about their eligibility, along with reasons for rejection if any, within a stipulated time.
The concerned authority has not yet released the last date officially.
